mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_trial_balance_run (id, ledger_book_id, period_id, run_no, as_of_sequence, status, total_debit, total_credit, content_hash, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{ledgerBookId}, #{periodId}, #{runNo}, #{asOfSequence}, #{status}, #{totalDebit}, #{totalCredit}, #{contentHash}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(run_no), 0) FROM t_trial_balance_run WHERE ledger_book_id = #{ledgerBookId} AND period_id = #{periodId}

SELECT r.id trial_balance_run_id, r.ledger_book_id, r.period_id, r.run_no, r.as_of_sequence, r.status, r.total_debit, r.total_credit, r.content_hash, r.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_trial_balance_line l WHERE l.run_id = r.id) line_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_trial_balance_exception x WHERE x.run_id = r.id) exception_count FROM t_trial_balance_run r WHERE r.ledger_book_id = #{ledgerBookId} AND r.period_id = #{periodId} AND r.run_no = #{runNo}

SELECT r.id trial_balance_run_id, r.ledger_book_id, r.period_id, r.run_no, r.as_of_sequence, r.status, r.total_debit, r.total_credit, r.content_hash, r.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_trial_balance_line l WHERE l.run_id = r.id) line_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_trial_balance_exception x WHERE x.run_id = r.id) exception_count FROM t_trial_balance_run r WHERE r.ledger_book_id = #{ledgerBookId} AND r.period_id = #{periodId} ORDER BY r.run_no DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_trial_balance_run WHERE ledger_book_id = #{ledgerBookId} AND period_id = #{periodId}
